_comment: Baseline for the CI smoke run: deploy/loadtest/chat.js against the compose stack on a
GitHub-hosted runner, with the local hash embedder and a mock upstream. These numbers
are therefore about *this repository's* code paths and nothing else — there is no real
provider in that environment, so the absolute values mean nothing next to a production
deployment and everything next to the previous commit.
Recorded on a 2-core ubuntu-latest runner at RPS=10 for 2 minutes. Refresh with:
and say in the commit message why the number moved.
